Name: Aimon's Bus Interior
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][i][font=Tahoma][color=#ffe599][b]Ever wanted to know what's inside the Bus? Now you can enter and explore it![/b]
[/color][/font][color=#ffe599]-------------------------------------------[/color][/i]
[/size][font=Tahoma][center][size=3]This mod adds custom Bus interior map that player can enter and interact with.
This is just a simple small extra map mod that doesn't add any new game changing stuff. 
[/size][/center][size=3][list]
[color=#ffe599]
[/color][/list][/size][/font][b]Features:[/b][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[list]
[*] A couple of new events (just to bring a bit more life into the game) (for now it's just one event but I'll add more soon)
[*]New lootable trash can with unique (sometimes rare) drops
[*]Seasonal and conditional bus interior decor
[/list][/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3][color=#93c47d][b]Compatibility[/b]:[/color]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=3]with any recolor[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=3]with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Valley and most other expansion mods[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=3]with most mods that change the look of BusStop map[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3]
[color=#ffe599][b]Installation:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, Farm Type Manager[/size]
[*][size=3](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu﻿[/size]
[*]Unzip "Aimon's Bus Interior" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size]
[/list][/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3][color=#ffe599][b]Config:[/b][/color]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=3]Cleaner bus - true\false (if true - removes most of the trash decor from bus map from the start. Else the bus will become cleaner automatically after finishing the CommunityCentre vault bundle.)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=3]Lootable Trash Bin - true\false (Adds lootable trash bin in bus.)[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[center][b][color=#ffe599]Mods used on screenshots:[/color][/b]
----------------------------
Stardew Foliage Redone
Stardew Valley Expanded
----------------------------[/center]
[/size][/font][center][/center][size=3][font=Tahoma][color=#ffe599]
[/color][/font][/size]
